extName.description: The extension name in Chrome and the Chrome Web Store. Keep the brand name; at most 75 characters.

extDescription.message: Ordena y agrupa todas las pestañas en un clic; guarda y restaura ventanas enteras como sesiones. Sin conexión ni cuenta, todo local.
extDescription.description: The store summary and the line under the name at chrome://extensions. At most 132 characters.

localeCode.description: Do not translate. The language code of this file itself (en, ko, es, ja), not a word: it picks the plural rules and number formats that match this file's text, also when Chrome falls back to it for a language the extension does not ship.

actionTitle.message: Tab Organizer: haz clic para ordenar las pestañas, clic derecho para sesiones
actionTitle.description: Tooltip of the toolbar icon. Teaches the two gestures.

cmdSaveSession.message: Guardar la ventana actual como sesión

cmdOpenDashboard.description: Keyboard command that opens the app page.

cmdAssembleTabs.message: ¡Reunir! (mover las pestañas de todas las ventanas a esta)
cmdAssembleTabs.description: Keyboard command and right-click menu item: the action name, then what it does in brackets.

assembleName.description: Short name of the action that moves every window's tabs into the current one. Shown on a button.

commonCancel.description: Button that closes a dialog without doing anything.

commonSentenceJoin.description: How two complete sentences stand side by side in one text. $1 and $2 are full sentences. Most languages put a space between them; languages written without spaces (Japanese) put nothing.

commonFactJoin.description: How two short facts are separated on one line, such as "3 windows · 87 tabs". $1 and $2 are the facts (either may itself be a joined list). Keep the middle dot separator unless your language uses another.

commonLoading.description: Shown while something (a session's tabs, the saved sessions, the open windows) is being read.

commonClose.description: Button or label that closes a dialog or panel.

tabCount_one.description: A number of browser tabs. $1 is the formatted count.

tabCount_other.description: A number of browser tabs. $1 is the formatted count.

windowCount_one.description: A number of browser windows. $1 is the formatted count.

windowCount_other.description: A number of browser windows. $1 is the formatted count.

settingsSubtitle.message: Los cambios se guardan al hacerlos.
settingsSubtitle.description: Line under the Settings dialog title: there is no Save button, every change is stored at once.

settingsSaved.description: Short toast shown after any setting was stored.

settingsSaveFailed.message: No se pudo guardar ese ajuste: $1
settingsSaveFailed.description: Error line shown when Chrome refused to store a setting. $1 is Chrome's own error message (usually English) or the word for an unknown error.

settingsUnknownError.description: Fills the error message of settingsSaveFailed when Chrome gave no reason. One lower-case word.

settingsAdvanced.description: Label of a fold in the Settings dialog that hides the settings people rarely change. One short word.

settingsAdvancedToggle.description: Tooltip of the Advanced fold in the Settings dialog.

settingsSortingTitle.description: Heading of the Settings section about sorting tabs.

settingsSortingDescription.message: Lo que hace un clic en el icono de la barra de herramientas.
settingsSortingDescription.description: Explanation under the Sorting heading in Settings.

settingsSortBy.description: Label of the dropdown that chooses how tabs are ordered.

settingsSortByTitle.message: Cómo se ordenan las pestañas al hacer clic en el icono de la barra de herramientas
settingsSortByTitle.description: Tooltip of the Sort by dropdown in Settings.

settingsSortByUrl.description: Sort by dropdown option: order tabs by their web address. Short.

settingsSortByTitleOption.description: Sort by dropdown option: order tabs alphabetically by page title. Short.

settingsSortByCustom.description: Sort by dropdown option: group tabs by site with the options shown under it. Short.

settingsTabGroups.description: Label of the dropdown that decides which tabs count as the same site when sorting by Custom.

settingsTabGroupsHint.message: Qué cuenta como el mismo sitio.
settingsTabGroupsHint.description: Grey hint under the Tab groups setting.

settingsGroupingSubdomain.description: Tab groups dropdown option: mail.example.com and www.example.com are different sites. Short.

settingsGroupingDomain.description: Tab groups dropdown option: every subdomain of example.com is one site. Short.

settingsGroupingDirection.description: Label of the dropdown that chooses which end of the tab strip decides the order of the site groups.

settingsGroupingDirectionHint.message: Qué extremo de la barra de pestañas decide el orden de los sitios.
settingsGroupingDirectionHint.description: Grey hint under the Grouping direction setting.

settingsPreserveOrder.message: Conservar el orden dentro de los grupos
settingsPreserveOrder.description: Label of a switch: keep each site's tabs in their current order instead of sorting them.

settingsPreserveOrderHint.message: Mantiene las pestañas de cada sitio en el orden en que las abriste.
settingsPreserveOrderHint.description: Grey hint under the Preserve order within groups switch.

settingsDuplicateTabs.description: Label of the dropdown that chooses what happens to tabs with the same address.

settingsDuplicateTabsHint.message: Cuando la misma dirección está abierta más de una vez.
settingsDuplicateTabsHint.description: Grey hint under the Duplicate tabs setting.

settingsDuplicateKeepOne.description: Duplicate tabs dropdown option: close the extra copies. Short.

settingsDuplicateKeepAll.description: Duplicate tabs dropdown option: leave them alone. Short.

settingsDuplicateGroup.description: Duplicate tabs dropdown option: put the copies in one tab group. Short.

settingsSortingAdvancedDescription.description: Small grey text beside the Advanced fold of the Sorting section, listing what is inside.

settingsSortPinned.description: Label of a switch in Settings.

settingsSortPinnedHint.message: Desactivado: las pestañas fijadas se quedan exactamente donde están.
settingsSortPinnedHint.description: Grey hint under the Sort pinned tabs switch.

settingsGroupSuspended.description: Label of a switch in Settings. Suspended tabs are pages unloaded by a tab suspender extension.

settingsGroupSuspendedHint.message: Activado: las pestañas suspendidas pasan al principio como un solo bloque.
settingsGroupSuspendedHint.description: Grey hint under the Group suspended tabs together switch.

settingsSuspenderId.message: ID de la extensión de suspensión de pestañas
settingsSuspenderId.description: Label of a text field holding another extension's 32-letter id.

settingsSuspenderIdHint.message: La extensión cuyas páginas suspendidas se reconocen. Si está vacío, se usa The Marvellous Suspender.
settingsSuspenderIdHint.description: Grey hint under the Tab suspender extension ID field. Keep the extension name The Marvellous Suspender as it is.

settingsSuspenderIdInvalid.message: 32 letras de la a a la p
settingsSuspenderIdInvalid.description: Short red error beside the extension id field: an id is exactly 32 letters from a to p. Keep the letters a and p.

settingsSessionsTitle.description: Heading of the Settings section about saved sessions and automatic snapshots.

settingsSessionsDescription.message: Las instantáneas automáticas son la red de seguridad ante un fallo o una ventana cerrada. Se quedan en este dispositivo.
settingsSessionsDescription.description: Explanation under the Sessions heading in Settings.

settingsSessionsAdvancedDescription.description: Small grey text beside the Advanced fold of the Sessions section, listing what is inside.

settingsAutoSnapshots.description: Label of the switch that turns timed snapshots of the open windows on or off.

settingsAutoSnapshotsTitle.message: Guardar lo que está abierto cada cierto tiempo, sin preguntar
settingsAutoSnapshotsTitle.description: Tooltip of the Automatic snapshots switch.

settingsSnapshotInterval.description: Label of the dropdown that chooses how often a snapshot is taken.

settingsSnapshotIntervalHint.description: Grey hint under Snapshot interval: the range a typed-in custom interval may take. $1 is the smallest number of minutes, $2 the largest.

settingsIntervalEvery_one.description: Snapshot interval dropdown option for one minute. $1 is the formatted number of minutes (1) and may be left out.

settingsIntervalEvery_other.description: Snapshot interval dropdown option. $1 is the formatted number of minutes.

settingsIntervalCustom.description: Snapshot interval dropdown option that shows a field to type any number of minutes. Short.

settingsIntervalCustomLabel.message: Intervalo personalizado de instantáneas en minutos
settingsIntervalCustomLabel.description: Screen-reader label of the number field for a custom snapshot interval.

settingsMinutesUnit.description: Unit shown right after the number field of a custom snapshot interval. One short word.

settingsKeepLast.description: Label in front of the number field for how many automatic snapshots are kept; the field is followed by settingsSnapshotsUnit.

settingsKeepLastHint.message: Las instantáneas más antiguas se eliminan primero. Las protegidas nunca cuentan.
settingsKeepLastHint.description: Grey hint under the Keep last setting.

settingsSnapshotsUnit.description: Unit shown right after the number field of the Keep last setting. One short word.

settingsLazyRestore.description: Label of the dropdown that chooses whether restored tabs load only when visited.

settingsLazyRestoreHint.message: Abre las pestañas sin cargarlas hasta que las visites.
settingsLazyRestoreHint.description: Grey hint under the Lazy restore setting.

settingsLazyAuto.description: Lazy restore dropdown option: only when a session has more tabs than $1, the formatted threshold (LAZY_AUTO_THRESHOLD in src/constants.ts).

settingsBackupTitle.description: Heading of the Settings section about exporting and importing sessions.

settingsBackupDescription.message: Las sesiones solo están en este dispositivo. Exporta un archivo para llevarlas a otro sitio.
settingsBackupDescription.description: Explanation under the Backup heading in Settings.

settingsExportEverything.description: Label of the row with the button that exports every session to a file.

settingsExportEverythingHint.message: Sesiones guardadas e instantáneas, en un solo archivo JSON.
settingsExportEverythingHint.description: Grey hint under Export everything. Keep JSON as it is.

settingsExportButton.description: Button that starts the export (a choice follows). Short.

settingsImport.description: Label of the row with the button that imports sessions from a file or pasted text.

settingsImportHint.message: JSON, marcadores en HTML, una lista en Markdown o URLs sin formato.
settingsImportHint.description: Grey hint under Import: the formats it reads. Keep JSON, HTML, Markdown and URLs as they are.

settingsImportButton.description: Button that opens the import dialog. Short.

settingsBackupAdvancedDescription.description: Small grey text beside the Advanced fold of the Backup section, listing what is inside.

settingsShortcutsTitle.description: Heading of the Settings section listing the extension's keyboard commands.

settingsShortcutsDescription.message: En una instalación nueva, Chrome asigna $1 a ordenar y $3 a $2 si ninguna otra extensión usa esas teclas. Los demás comandos empiezan sin tecla.
settingsShortcutsDescription.description: Explanation under the Keyboard shortcuts heading. $1 is the sort key (e.g. Alt + Shift + S), $2 is the name of the Assemble! action, $3 is its key (e.g. Alt + Shift + A).

settingsSortCommand.message: Ordenar las pestañas de esta ventana (igual que hacer clic en el icono)
settingsSortCommand.description: Name of the keyboard command that sorts, in the shortcuts list.

settingsUnnamedCommand.description: Shortcuts list: a command Chrome reported without any name.

settingsShortcutNotSet.description: Shortcuts list: the command has no key. Short.

settingsShortcutSuggestedHint.message: Tecla sugerida: $1. Chrome no la ha asignado aquí; puedes configurarla en la página de combinaciones de teclas de Chrome.
settingsShortcutSuggestedHint.description: Grey hint under an unbound command in the shortcuts list. $1 is the key, e.g. Alt + Shift + A.

settingsShortcutsChangeOnlyInChrome.message: Estas combinaciones de teclas solo se pueden cambiar en la configuración de combinaciones de teclas de Chrome.
settingsShortcutsChangeOnlyInChrome.description: Note beside the Change in Chrome button.

settingsShortcutsLoading.message: Leyendo las combinaciones de teclas de Chrome…
settingsShortcutsLoading.description: Shown while Chrome has not yet reported the keyboard shortcuts.

settingsShortcutsFailed.message: Chrome no ha informado de las combinaciones de teclas. Abre su página de combinaciones de teclas para verlas.
settingsShortcutsFailed.description: Shown when Chrome could not list the keyboard shortcuts.

settingsChangeInChrome.description: Button that opens Chrome's keyboard shortcuts page. Short.

settingsChangeInChromeTitle.message: Abrir la página de combinaciones de teclas de Chrome
settingsChangeInChromeTitle.description: Tooltip of the Change in Chrome button.

settingsKeyCommand.description: Name of the Mac Command key (⌘) as printed on keyboards in this language. Shown in a small key chip.

settingsKeyControl.description: Name of the Mac Control key (⌃) as printed on keyboards in this language. Shown in a small key chip.

settingsKeyOption.description: Name of the Mac Option key (⌥) as printed on keyboards in this language. Shown in a small key chip.

settingsKeyCtrl.description: Name of the Ctrl key on Windows, Linux and ChromeOS keyboards. Shown in a small key chip.

settingsKeyAlt.description: Name of the Alt key on Windows, Linux and ChromeOS keyboards. Shown in a small key chip.

settingsKeyShift.description: Name of the Shift key as printed on keyboards in this language. Shown in a small key chip.

settingsKeySearch.description: Name of the ChromeOS Search key. Shown in a small key chip.

settingsKeyNameComma.description: Name of the comma key as printed on keyboards in this language. Shown in a small key chip of a keyboard shortcut.

settingsKeyNamePeriod.description: Name of the period (full stop) key as printed on keyboards in this language. Shown in a small key chip of a keyboard shortcut.

settingsKeyNameSpace.description: Name of the space bar as printed on keyboards in this language. Shown in a small key chip of a keyboard shortcut.

settingsKeyNameUp.description: Name of the up arrow key as printed on keyboards in this language. Shown in a small key chip of a keyboard shortcut.

settingsKeyNameDown.description: Name of the down arrow key as printed on keyboards in this language. Shown in a small key chip of a keyboard shortcut.

settingsKeyNameLeft.description: Name of the left arrow key as printed on keyboards in this language. Shown in a small key chip of a keyboard shortcut.

settingsKeyNameRight.description: Name of the right arrow key as printed on keyboards in this language. Shown in a small key chip of a keyboard shortcut.

settingsKeyNameHome.description: Name of the Home key as printed on keyboards in this language. Shown in a small key chip of a keyboard shortcut.

settingsKeyNameEnd.description: Name of the End key as printed on keyboards in this language. Shown in a small key chip of a keyboard shortcut.

settingsKeyNamePageUp.description: Name of the Page Up key as printed on keyboards in this language. Shown in a small key chip of a keyboard shortcut.

settingsKeyNamePageDown.description: Name of the Page Down key as printed on keyboards in this language. Shown in a small key chip of a keyboard shortcut.

settingsKeyNameInsert.description: Name of the Insert key as printed on keyboards in this language. Shown in a small key chip of a keyboard shortcut.

settingsKeyNameDelete.description: Name of the Delete key as printed on keyboards in this language. Shown in a small key chip of a keyboard shortcut.

settingsKeyNameTab.description: Name of the Tab key as printed on keyboards in this language. Shown in a small key chip of a keyboard shortcut.

settingsKeyNameEscape.description: Name of the Escape key as printed on keyboards in this language. Shown in a small key chip of a keyboard shortcut.

settingsKeyNameEnter.description: Name of the Enter (Return) key as printed on keyboards in this language. Shown in a small key chip of a keyboard shortcut.

settingsKeyNameBackspace.description: Name of the Backspace key as printed on keyboards in this language. Shown in a small key chip of a keyboard shortcut.

settingsKeyNameMediaNextTrack.description: Name of the media key that skips to the next track as printed on keyboards in this language. Shown in a small key chip of a keyboard shortcut.

settingsKeyNameMediaPlayPause.description: Name of the media key that plays or pauses as printed on keyboards in this language. Shown in a small key chip of a keyboard shortcut.

settingsKeyNameMediaPrevTrack.description: Name of the media key that goes back to the previous track as printed on keyboards in this language. Shown in a small key chip of a keyboard shortcut.

settingsKeyNameMediaStop.description: Name of the media key that stops playback as printed on keyboards in this language. Shown in a small key chip of a keyboard shortcut.

sessionDefaultName.description: Default name of a saved session, stored with it. $1 is the capture time as 2026-08-29 14:03 (keep as is), $2 is a window count such as "3 windows", $3 a tab count such as "87 tabs". Keep the · separators.

sessionSnapshotDefaultName.description: Default name of an automatic snapshot. $1 is the capture time as 2026-08-29 14:03 (keep as is), $2 is a window count such as "3 windows", $3 a tab count such as "87 tabs". Keep the · separators.

sessionRecoveredName.description: Name given to the snapshot recovered after a browser restart. $1 is its capture time as 2026-08-29 14:03.

sessionUnreadableMessage.message: Guardada con una versión más reciente de Tab Organizer. Actualiza para abrirla.
sessionUnreadableMessage.description: Shown in the saved list instead of a session this version cannot read. Tab Organizer is the extension name.

sessionUnreadableSchema.description: Short technical label after the unreadable-session message. $1 is the data format version number, e.g. 2.

sessionOriginAlarm.description: Small lowercase label on a snapshot taken automatically on a timer. One short word.

sessionOriginManual.description: Small lowercase label on a snapshot taken by clicking the toolbar icon. One short word.

sessionOriginStartup.description: Small lowercase label on a snapshot taken when the browser started. One short word.

sessionOriginRecovered.description: Small lowercase label on the snapshot recovered after a browser restart. One short word.

sessionOriginImport.description: Small lowercase label on a session that came from an imported file. One short word.

sessionSavedAt.description: Lowercase fragment after the window and tab counts of a session, e.g. "2 windows · 9 tabs · 4 KB · saved Aug 29, 2026, 14:03". $1 is the date and time.

sessionDeleteLabel.description: Tooltip and screen reader label of the trash icon button on a session row.

sessionDeleteTitle.description: Title of the dialog that confirms deleting a saved session.

sessionSnapshotDeleteTitle.description: Title of the dialog that confirms deleting an automatic snapshot.

sessionDeleteBody.message: «$1» se eliminará de este dispositivo. No se puede deshacer.
sessionDeleteBody.description: Body of the delete confirmation dialog. $1 is the session name or the snapshot's date; use the language's quotation marks around it.

sessionRestoreTitle_one.description: Title of the dialog that confirms opening a large session. $1 is the formatted tab count.

sessionRestoreTitle_other.description: Title of the dialog that confirms opening a large session. $1 is the formatted tab count.

sessionRestoreBody.message: Las restauraciones grandes pueden tardar y usar mucha memoria.
sessionRestoreBody.description: Body of the restore confirmation dialog, shown after the sentence saying where the tabs will open (restoreDestinationHere / restoreDestinationNewWindows).

sessionRestoreLazyLabel.message: Cargar las pestañas en diferido (recomendado: se cargan al hacer clic)
sessionRestoreLazyLabel.description: Checkbox label in the restore confirmation dialog: restored tabs stay unloaded until clicked.

sessionRestoreButton.description: Confirm button of the restore dialog: opens the session's tabs. Short button text.

sessionGone.description: Error shown when a session that was deleted meanwhile (for example from another tab) is opened, exported or shown.

sessionSnapshotGone.description: Error shown when opening a snapshot that was deleted meanwhile.

sessionSwitchedToOpenTab.message: Se ha cambiado a esa pestaña, que ya estaba abierta.
sessionSwitchedToOpenTab.description: Toast after clicking a saved tab whose page was already open: the open tab was brought forward instead of opening it again.

sessionNameLabel.description: Screen reader label of the text field for renaming a session.

sessionRenameHint.message: Intro para guardar, Esc para cancelar
sessionRenameHint.description: Tooltip of the rename field. Enter and Escape are keyboard keys.

sessionRename.description: Menu item and tooltip on the session title that starts renaming the session. Short.

sessionRenameLabel.message: Cambiar el nombre de la sesión
sessionRenameLabel.description: Tooltip and screen reader label of the pencil icon button next to the session name.

sessionOpenTitle.message: Abrir esta sesión en ventanas nuevas
sessionOpenTitle.description: Tooltip of the Open button on a saved session.

sessionMoreActions.description: Tooltip and screen reader label of the ⋯ menu button on a session or snapshot.

sessionOpenHere.description: Menu item: open the saved session's tabs in the current window. Short menu item.

sessionWindowsIn.description: Screen reader label of a session's window list. $1 is the session name.

sessionOpenWindowTitle.message: Abrir las pestañas de esta ventana en una ventana nueva
sessionOpenWindowTitle.description: Tooltip of the Open window button on one window of a saved session.

sessionOpenWindow.description: Small button on one window of a saved session: open its tabs in a new window. Short button text.

sessionOpenWindowHereTitle.message: Abrir las pestañas de esta ventana en la ventana actual
sessionOpenWindowHereTitle.description: Tooltip of the Open here button on one window of a saved session.

sessionOpenWindowHere.description: Small button on one window of a saved session: open its tabs in the current window. Short button text.

sessionRemoveWindowTitle.message: Quitar esta ventana de la sesión
sessionRemoveWindowTitle.description: Tooltip of the Remove button on one window of a saved session.

sessionRemoveWindow.description: Small button that removes one window from a saved session. Short button text.

sessionCopyLink.description: Tooltip and screen reader label of the link icon button on a saved tab: copies its address.

sessionRemoveTab.description: Tooltip and screen reader label of the × icon button on a saved tab.

sessionSnapshotLabel.description: Screen reader label of the snapshot view. $1 is the snapshot's date and time.

sessionSnapshotOpenTitle.message: Abrir esta instantánea en ventanas nuevas
sessionSnapshotOpenTitle.description: Tooltip of the Open button on an automatic snapshot.

sessionKeep.description: Button on an automatic snapshot that moves it into the saved sessions. Short button text; also appears in bold inside sessionSnapshotExplainer.

sessionKeepTitle.message: Mover a las sesiones guardadas, donde nada la elimina
sessionKeepTitle.description: Tooltip of the Keep button on an automatic snapshot.

sessionKeptNotice.description: Toast after Keep moved a snapshot into the saved sessions. $1 is the new saved session's name; use the language's quotation marks.

sessionSnapshotExplainer_one.message: Las instantáneas se toman automáticamente y solo se conserva $1, la más reciente. Pulsa $2 para mover esta a tus sesiones guardadas, donde nada la elimina.
sessionSnapshotExplainer_one.description: Explanation under a snapshot's title. $1 is the formatted number of snapshots kept, $2 is the bold word of the Keep button (sessionKeep); keep $2 exactly once.

sessionSnapshotExplainer_other.message: Las instantáneas se toman automáticamente y solo se conservan las últimas $1. Pulsa $2 para mover esta a tus sesiones guardadas, donde nada la elimina.
sessionSnapshotExplainer_other.description: Explanation under a snapshot's title. $1 is the formatted number of snapshots kept, $2 is the bold word of the Keep button (sessionKeep); keep $2 exactly once.

sessionSnapshotWindows.description: Screen reader label of a snapshot's window list.

expMenuJson.description: Downloads the session as a JSON file. Export menu item; keep it short (at most about 30 characters).

expMenuMarkdown.description: Downloads the session as a Markdown file. Export menu item; keep it short (at most about 30 characters).

expMenuText.description: Downloads the session as a plain-text list of links. Export menu item; keep it short (at most about 30 characters).

expMenuHtml.description: Downloads the session as a bookmarks HTML file that browsers can import. Export menu item; keep it short (at most about 30 characters).

expMenuCsv.description: Downloads the session as a CSV spreadsheet file. Export menu item; keep it short (at most about 30 characters).

expExportedJson.description: Toast after an export. $1 is the name of what was exported (a session name, possibly narrowed like 'Work (Window 2)').

expExportedMarkdown.description: Toast after an export. $1 is the name of what was exported (a session name, possibly narrowed like 'Work (Window 2)').

expExportedText.description: Toast after an export. $1 is the name of what was exported (a session name, possibly narrowed like 'Work (Window 2)').

expExportedHtml.message: Se ha exportado «$1» como marcadores HTML.
expExportedHtml.description: Toast after an export. $1 is the name of what was exported (a session name, possibly narrowed like 'Work (Window 2)').

expExportedCsv.description: Toast after an export. $1 is the name of what was exported (a session name, possibly narrowed like 'Work (Window 2)').

expScopeWindow.description: Name of an export narrowed to one window, used in the file name and the confirmation. $1 is the session name, $2 the window number.

expScopeGroup.description: Name of an export narrowed to one tab group. $1 is the session name, $2 the group title.

expUntitledGroup.description: Stands in for a tab group without a title, in export names and as a heading in Markdown exports.

expWindowLabel.description: Heading for one window inside Markdown and bookmarks HTML exports. $1 is the window number.

commonCopiedLinks_one.description: Toast after copying links (of a session, a window, a group or the selected tabs). $1 is the formatted number of links.

expCopiedMarkdown_one.message: Se ha copiado $1 enlace como Markdown.
expCopiedMarkdown_one.description: Toast after copying links as a Markdown list. $1 is the formatted number of links.

commonCopiedLinks_other.description: Toast after copying links (of a session, a window, a group or the selected tabs). $1 is the formatted number of links.

expCopiedMarkdown_other.message: Se han copiado $1 enlaces como Markdown.
expCopiedMarkdown_other.description: Toast after copying links as a Markdown list. $1 is the formatted number of links.

expCopiedLink.description: Toast after copying the link of a single tab.

expNothingToExport.message: No hay nada que exportar: esta selección no tiene pestañas.
expNothingToExport.description: Toast when the chosen window or group holds no tabs.

expCollecting.description: Progress toast while every session is read for a backup. $1 is how many are read so far, $2 the total.

expExportedAll_one.message: Se ha exportado $1 sesión como JSON.
expExportedAll_one.description: Toast after 'Export everything' (a JSON backup). $1 is the formatted number of sessions.

expUnreadable_one.description: Sentence added after the export toast when some sessions could not be read. $1 is the formatted number of sessions.

expImportButton_one.description: Button that imports the previewed sessions. $1 is the formatted number of sessions. Keep it short.

expImportedNotice_one.description: Toast after an import. $1 is the formatted number of sessions imported.

expSessionCount_one.description: A number of sessions, in the import preview totals. $1 is the formatted count.

expExportedAll_other.message: Se han exportado $1 sesiones como JSON.
expExportedAll_other.description: Toast after 'Export everything' (a JSON backup). $1 is the formatted number of sessions.

expUnreadable_other.description: Sentence added after the export toast when some sessions could not be read. $1 is the formatted number of sessions.

expImportButton_other.description: Button that imports the previewed sessions. $1 is the formatted number of sessions. Keep it short.

expImportedNotice_other.description: Toast after an import. $1 is the formatted number of sessions imported.

expSessionCount_other.description: A number of sessions, in the import preview totals. $1 is the formatted count.

expNothingToExportAll.message: No hay nada que exportar: aún no hay sesiones guardadas.
expNothingToExportAll.description: Toast when 'Export everything' finds no sessions.

expClipboardUnavailable.message: No se pudo copiar: este navegador no ha permitido el acceso al portapapeles desde esta página.
expClipboardUnavailable.description: Error when the clipboard cannot be used at all.

expCopyFailed.message: No se pudo copiar al portapapeles: $1
expCopyFailed.description: Error when copying failed. $1 is the reason, a complete sentence already in your language (one of the error* messages).

expCopyFailedPlain.message: No se pudo copiar al portapapeles.
expCopyFailedPlain.description: Error when copying failed and there is no reason that can be shown.

expMenuButton.description: Accessible name of the export menu's icon button.

expMenuTitleGroup.description: Tooltip of the export button on a tab group.

expMenuTitleWindow.description: Tooltip of the export button on a window.

expMenuTitleAll.description: Tooltip of the export button on a whole session.

expCopyLinks.description: Export menu item that copies every link as plain text. Keep it short.

expCopyMarkdown.description: Export menu item that copies every link as a Markdown list. Keep it short.

expImportedName.description: Name given to a session read from a JSON import. $1 is the session's original name.

expImportedBookmarks.description: Name of a session made from bookmarks that were not in any folder.

expImportedLinks.description: Name of the session made from pasted links or a Markdown/text file.

expErrorMalformedJson.description: Import error when the pasted or chosen text starts like JSON but cannot be read as JSON.

expErrorMalformedJsonAt.message: No es un JSON válido (línea $1, columna $2).
expErrorMalformedJsonAt.description: Import error when the text cannot be read as JSON, with where the reading stopped. $1 is the line number, $2 the column number.

expErrorNoSessionsList.message: El paquete exportado no tiene una lista "sessions".
expErrorNoSessionsList.description: Import error for a Tab Organizer JSON file without its sessions list. Keep "sessions" as is: it is the field name in the file.

expErrorNoSessions.description: Import error for an empty export.

expErrorInvalidSession.message: La sesión $1 no es un registro de sesión válido de Tab Organizer.
expErrorInvalidSession.description: Import error. $1 is the 1-based position of the bad session in the file.

expErrorNotExport.message: El JSON no es una exportación de Tab Organizer.
expErrorNotExport.description: Import error for JSON from somewhere else.

expErrorSchemaVersion.message: Versión de esquema de sesión no admitida: $1 (esta versión lee la $2).
expErrorSchemaVersion.description: Import error for a file from another version of the extension. $1 is the file's schema version, $2 the one this build reads.

expErrorNoBookmarks.message: No se han encontrado marcadores en el HTML.
expErrorNoBookmarks.description: Import error for a bookmarks HTML file without links.

expErrorNoUrls.description: Import error for pasted text or Markdown without links.

expErrorNothingToImport.message: No hay nada que importar: pega una exportación JSON de Tab Organizer, un archivo HTML de marcadores, Markdown o una lista de URLs.
expErrorNothingToImport.description: Import error when the pasted text is not any known format.

expWarnNoWindows.description: Import preview warning. $1 is a session name.

expWarnEmptyWindow.description: Import preview warning. $1 is a session name, $2 a window number.

expErrorTooLarge.message: Es demasiado grande para importarlo ($1). El límite es $2.
expErrorTooLarge.description: Import error for an oversized file or paste. $1 is its size, $2 the limit (both like '25.0 MB').

expErrorFileRead.message: No se pudo leer este archivo: $1
expErrorFileRead.description: Import error when the chosen file cannot be read. $1 is the reason, a complete sentence already in your language (one of the error* messages).

expErrorFileReadPlain.message: No se pudo leer este archivo.
expErrorFileReadPlain.description: Import error when the chosen file cannot be read and there is no reason that can be shown.

expDetectedLinks.description: Import format name for a plain list of links, shown after 'Detected'.

expDetected.description: Import preview line; the session totals follow it after a ' · '. $1 is the format name (drawn in bold), e.g. 'Bookmarks HTML'.

expImportDescription.message: Una exportación JSON de Tab Organizer, un archivo HTML de marcadores, Markdown o una lista de enlaces sin formato. Las sesiones importadas se añaden a la lista de guardadas en este dispositivo; no se sube nada.
expImportDescription.description: Explanation under the import dialog's title.

expChooseFile.description: Label of the import dialog's file picker.

expPasteLabel.description: Label of the import dialog's paste box.

expPastePlaceholder.description: Placeholder of the paste box: an example bare link, a line break, then a Markdown link. Only translate the word 'Docs'; keep the URLs and the '- [..](..)' syntax.

expPreviewWindow_one.description: Import preview line for one window. $2 is the window number, $1 the formatted number of tabs in it.

expMoreTabs_one.description: Import preview: tabs of a window not listed. $1 is the formatted count.

expPreviewWindow_other.description: Import preview line for one window. $2 is the window number, $1 the formatted number of tabs in it.

expMoreTabs_other.description: Import preview: tabs of a window not listed. $1 is the formatted count.

expMoreWindows_one.description: Import preview: windows of a session not listed. $1 is the formatted count.

expMoreWindows_other.description: Import preview: windows of a session not listed. $1 is the formatted count.

expMoreSessions_one.description: Import preview: sessions not listed. $1 is the formatted count.

expMoreSessions_other.description: Import preview: sessions not listed. $1 is the formatted count.

expImport.description: Import button while nothing importable has been chosen yet. Keep it short.

appNothingToSaveWindow.message: No hay nada que guardar: esta ventana solo contiene Tab Organizer.
appNothingToSaveWindow.description: Notice toast after Save when the current window holds nothing but the extension's own page. 'Tab Organizer' is the extension name.

appNothingToSaveAll.message: No hay nada que guardar: ninguna ventana abierta contiene algo aparte de Tab Organizer.
appNothingToSaveAll.description: Notice toast after 'Save all windows' when no window holds anything but the extension's own page. 'Tab Organizer' is the extension name.

appNothingToSaveTabs.message: No hay nada que guardar: las pestañas seleccionadas ya no están abiertas.
appNothingToSaveTabs.description: Notice toast after saving selected tabs when every selected tab has been closed meanwhile.

appSavedNotice.message: Se ha guardado «$1». Cámbiale el nombre desde su título.
appSavedNotice.description: Notice toast after a session is saved. $1 is the session's name. The second sentence tells the user that clicking the session's title renames it.

appOpenAlreadyRunning.message: Ya se está abriendo una sesión.
appOpenAlreadyRunning.description: Notice toast when the user opens a saved session while another one is still being opened (restored).

appSearchNothingFound.message: Nada en tus pestañas abiertas ni en tus sesiones guardadas.
appSearchNothingFound.description: Shown in the search results when nothing matches; a button offering to search automatic snapshots follows it.

appSearchHistoryTitle.message: Buscar también en las instantáneas automáticas
appSearchHistoryTitle.description: Tooltip of the button that extends the search to automatic snapshots (auto-saved sessions).

appSearchHistoryButton.description: Small button under empty search results that extends the search to automatic snapshots. Keep short (button). Use the same word for snapshots as everywhere else.

appHomeTitle.description: Tooltip of the extension name at the top left of the page, which is a link back to the open tabs view.

commonOpenSettingsTitle.description: Tooltip of the Settings button in the page header and of the link that opens the Settings dialog.

appSettings.description: Label of the Settings button in the page header. Keep short (button).

appResizeSidebarLabel.message: Cambiar el tamaño de la barra lateral
appResizeSidebarLabel.description: Screen-reader label of the draggable handle between the sidebar and the main pane.

appResizeSidebarTitle.message: Arrastra para cambiar el tamaño de la barra lateral; haz doble clic para restablecerlo
appResizeSidebarTitle.description: Tooltip of the draggable handle between the sidebar and the main pane.

appNavLabel.description: Screen-reader label of the sidebar navigation (open tabs, saved sessions, snapshots).

appNavOpenTabs.description: Sidebar row that shows the browser's currently open tabs. Keep short (menu item).

appNavTabsOpen_one.description: Tooltip on the tab count of the 'Open tabs' sidebar row. $1 is the formatted number of open tabs.

appNavTabsOpen_other.description: Tooltip on the tab count of the 'Open tabs' sidebar row. $1 is the formatted number of open tabs.

appNavSaved.description: Sidebar section heading above the list of saved sessions. Shown in uppercase. Keep short.

appNavNothingSaved.description: Shown in the sidebar's Saved section when there are no saved sessions.

commonWindowsAndTabs.description: A window count and a tab count on one line: the second line of a sidebar row, the Open tabs heading, the import preview. $1 is a window count phrase such as '2 windows', $2 a tab count phrase such as '14 tabs'. Change the separator or order if your language needs it.

appNavSavedAt.description: Third line of a saved session row in the sidebar. $1 is the date and time it was last saved, already formatted.

appNavNewerTitle.message: Guardada con una versión más reciente de Tab Organizer
appNavNewerTitle.description: Tooltip of the 'newer' badge on a session this version cannot read. 'Tab Organizer' is the extension name.

appNavNewerBadge.description: Small lowercase badge on a session saved by a newer version of the extension. One short word.

appNavAutoSaved.description: Sidebar section heading above the list of automatic snapshots. Use the same term for snapshots as everywhere else (settingsAutoSnapshots).

appNavHideSnapshots.description: Tooltip of the toggle that folds away the list of automatic snapshots.

appNavShowSnapshots.description: Tooltip of the toggle that unfolds the list of automatic snapshots.

appNavNoSnapshots.description: Label of the snapshots toggle in the sidebar when no automatic snapshot exists.

appNavSnapshotCount_one.description: Label of the snapshots toggle in the sidebar. $1 is the formatted number of automatic snapshots.

appNavSnapshotCount_other.description: Label of the snapshots toggle in the sidebar. $1 is the formatted number of automatic snapshots.

appNavRecoveredTitle.message: Tomada antes del último reinicio del navegador
appNavRecoveredTitle.description: Tooltip of the 'recovered' badge on the snapshot taken just before the browser was last restarted.

appNavRecoveredBadge.description: Small lowercase badge on the snapshot taken before the last browser restart. One short word.

appNavKeptTitle.message: Conservada: nunca se elimina para hacer sitio
appNavKeptTitle.description: Tooltip of the 'kept' badge on a snapshot that is protected from automatic deletion.

appNavKeptBadge.description: Small lowercase badge on a protected snapshot. One short word.

openHeading.description: Heading of the view that lists the browser's open windows and tabs; also the accessible name of that section and its sidebar entry. Short, at most 20 characters.

openSaveAllWindows.description: Button on the Open tabs view when more than one window is open: saves every window as one session. Short button text.

openSaveThisWindow.description: Button on the Open tabs view when only one window is open: saves it as a session. Short button text.

openSaveAllWindowsTitle.message: Guardar todas las ventanas abiertas como una sesión
openSaveAllWindowsTitle.description: Tooltip of the Save all windows button.

openSaveWindowTitle.description: Tooltip of a button that saves one browser window as a session.

openFirstRunHint.message: Aún no hay nada guardado. Pulsa $1 o haz clic derecho en el icono de Tab Organizer y elige $2. Para usar una combinación de teclas, $3.
openFirstRunHint.description: Hint shown on the Open tabs view while no session has been saved. $1 is the Save button's label (e.g. 'Save all windows'), shown in bold. $2 is the right-click menu item 'Save all windows as session', shown in bold. $3 is a link that opens Settings (openFirstRunHintSettingsLink). Keep 'Tab Organizer' as is.

openFirstRunHintSettingsLink.description: Link text inside openFirstRunHint ($3), after 'To use a keyboard shortcut,'. Opens the Settings dialog. Lower case, it continues the sentence.

openWindowsHeading.description: Screen-reader heading of the tree of live browser windows on the Open tabs view.

openNoWindows.message: No hay ventanas abiertas que mostrar.
openNoWindows.description: Shown in the Open tabs view when there is no browser window to list.

openThisWindow.description: Badge on the window the app page itself is in. Very short, at most 15 characters.

openThisWindowTitle.message: La ventana en la que está esta página

openSaveWindow.description: Small button on one window of the Open tabs list: saves that window as a session. Short button text.

openCloseWindow.description: Small button on one window of the Open tabs list, and the confirm button of the close-window dialog. Short button text.

openCloseWindowTooltip.message: Cerrar esta ventana y todas sus pestañas
openCloseWindowTooltip.description: Tooltip of the Close window button.

openGoToTab.description: Icon button (label and tooltip) on a tab row: switches to that tab.

openCloseTab.description: Icon button (label and tooltip) on a tab row: closes that tab.

openCloseWindowQuestion.description: Title of the dialog that confirms closing a browser window. $1 is the window's number in the list (1, 2, ...).

openCloseWindowBody_one.message: Se cerrará $1 pestaña. Guarda antes la ventana si quieres recuperarla.
openCloseWindowBody_one.description: Text of the close-window dialog. $1 is the formatted number of tabs in the window.

openCloseWindowBody_other.message: Se cerrarán $1 pestañas. Guarda antes la ventana si quieres recuperarlas.
openCloseWindowBody_other.description: Text of the close-window dialog. $1 is the formatted number of tabs in the window.

openCloseWindowIsCurrent.message: Es la ventana en la que está Tab Organizer.
openCloseWindowIsCurrent.description: Extra sentence after openCloseWindowBody when the window being closed holds the app page itself, so closing it closes the page too.

openCloseTabsQuestion_one.description: Title of the dialog that confirms closing the selected tabs. $1 is the formatted number of tabs.

openCloseTabsQuestion_other.description: Title of the dialog that confirms closing the selected tabs. $1 is the formatted number of tabs.

openCloseTabsBody.message: Se cerrarán todas las pestañas seleccionadas, incluidas las que estén dentro de un grupo contraído o más abajo en una ventana larga de lo que muestra la lista. Usa Guardar y cerrar si quieres recuperarlas.
openCloseTabsBody.description: Text of the dialog that confirms closing several selected tabs. 'Save & close' is the menu item openSaveAndClose and must read the same.

openCloseTabs.description: Confirm button of the dialog that closes the selected tabs. Short button text.

openClearSelection.description: Icon button (label and tooltip) that unticks every selected tab.

openSelectedTabs_one.description: Heading of the bar shown while tabs are ticked. $1 is the formatted number of ticked tabs.

openSelectedTabs_other.description: Heading of the bar shown while tabs are ticked. $1 is the formatted number of ticked tabs.

openSaveTabsTitle.description: Tooltip of the Save button in the selection bar.

openCopy.description: Button in the selection bar: copies the links of the selected tabs. Short button text.

openCopyTitle.message: Copiar los enlaces de estas pestañas
openCopyTitle.description: Tooltip of the Copy button in the selection bar.

openCloseTabsTitle.description: Tooltip of the Close button in the selection bar.

openMoreActions.message: Más acciones para las pestañas seleccionadas
openMoreActions.description: Label and tooltip of the menu button with more actions in the selection bar.

openSaveAndClose.description: Menu item: saves the selected tabs as a session, then closes them. Short menu item.

openCopyAs.description: Menu item that opens a submenu of copy formats. Short menu item.

openSelectLike.message: Seleccionar todas las pestañas de este sitio
openSelectLike.description: Menu item: selects every open tab on the same sites as the selected ones.

openSelectUnlike.message: Seleccionar todas las pestañas de otros sitios
openSelectUnlike.description: Menu item: selects every open tab on any other site than the selected ones.

openCopyFormatLinks.description: Copy format in the 'Copy as…' submenu: one link per line. Short menu item.

openCopyFormatMarkdown.description: Copy format in the 'Copy as…' submenu: Markdown [title](url) links. Short menu item.

openCopyFormatTitled.description: Copy format in the 'Copy as…' submenu: each tab's title on one line and its link on the next. Short menu item.

openCopiedLinksMarkdown_one.message: Se ha copiado $1 enlace como Markdown.
openCopiedLinksMarkdown_one.description: Toast after copying the selected tabs as Markdown links. $1 is the formatted number of links.

openCopiedLinksMarkdown_other.message: Se han copiado $1 enlaces como Markdown.
openCopiedLinksMarkdown_other.description: Toast after copying the selected tabs as Markdown links. $1 is the formatted number of links.

openCopiedLinksTitled_one.message: Se ha copiado $1 enlace con título.
openCopiedLinksTitled_one.description: Toast after copying the selected tabs as titles and links. $1 is the formatted number of links.

openCopiedLinksTitled_other.message: Se han copiado $1 enlaces con títulos.
openCopiedLinksTitled_other.description: Toast after copying the selected tabs as titles and links. $1 is the formatted number of links.

openClosedTabs_one.description: Toast after closing selected tabs. $1 is the formatted number of tabs.

openClosedTabs_other.description: Toast after closing selected tabs. $1 is the formatted number of tabs.

openKeptOpen_one.message: No se pudo guardar $1 pestaña, así que se ha dejado abierta.
openKeptOpen_one.description: Toast after 'Save & close' when some selected tabs could not be saved and so were not closed. $1 is the formatted number of those tabs.

openKeptOpen_other.message: No se pudieron guardar $1 pestañas, así que se han dejado abiertas.
openKeptOpen_other.description: Toast after 'Save & close' when some selected tabs could not be saved and so were not closed. $1 is the formatted number of those tabs.

openAssembleBusy.message: Aún se están reuniendo las pestañas, un momento.
openAssembleBusy.description: Toast when Assemble! is pressed while a previous run is still moving tabs.

openAssembleNothing.message: No hay nada que reunir: ninguna otra ventana tiene pestañas.
openAssembleNothing.description: Toast when Assemble! finds no other window to move tabs from.

openAssembleDone_one.message: Se ha reunido $1 ventana en esta.
openAssembleDone_one.description: Toast after Assemble! moved every other window's tabs into this window. $1 is the formatted number of windows gathered.

openAssembleDone_other.message: Se han reunido $1 ventanas en esta.
openAssembleDone_other.description: Toast after Assemble! moved every other window's tabs into this window. $1 is the formatted number of windows gathered.

openAssemblePartial_one.message: Se han reunido aquí las pestañas de $2; $1 ventana no se pudo mover y se ha dejado como estaba.
openAssemblePartial_one.description: Error line after Assemble! when some windows failed. $1 is the formatted number of windows that could not be moved. $2 is how many were gathered, already counted, e.g. '2 windows' (from windowCount).

openAssemblePartial_other.message: Se han reunido aquí las pestañas de $2; $1 ventanas no se pudieron mover y se han dejado como estaban.
openAssemblePartial_other.description: Error line after Assemble! when some windows failed. $1 is the formatted number of windows that could not be moved. $2 is how many were gathered, already counted, e.g. '2 windows' (from windowCount).

openUnsupportedUrl.message: Esta pestaña no se puede abrir (URL no admitida).
openUnsupportedUrl.description: Error shown when a saved tab's address is of a kind the extension refuses to open (data:, javascript:, another extension's page).

openNoCurrentWindow.message: No se pudo identificar esta ventana.
openNoCurrentWindow.description: Error shown when opening a session into this window fails because the browser did not report which window the page is in.

treeWindowLabel.description: Heading and screen-reader label of one browser window in a tab list. $1 is the window's number (1, 2, 3...). Short heading.

treeTabCountWithState.description: Window header line when the window is not in its normal state. $1 is a tab count such as "12 tabs", $2 is the window state such as "minimized". Keep the middle dot separator unless your language uses another.

treeWindowStateNormal.description: State of a browser window (neither minimized, maximized nor full screen). Shown lowercase after the tab count in a window header. One or two words.

treeWindowStateMinimized.description: State of a browser window that is minimized. Shown lowercase after the tab count in a window header. One or two words.

treeWindowStateMaximized.description: State of a browser window that is maximized. Shown lowercase after the tab count in a window header. One or two words.

treeWindowStateFullscreen.description: State of a browser window in full screen mode. Shown lowercase after the tab count in a window header. One or two words.

treeUntitledGroup.description: Name shown for a Chrome tab group that has no title. Short label on a small chip.

treeCollapseGroup.description: Tooltip of a tab group header while the group is open; clicking hides its tabs. $1 is the group's name.

treeExpandGroup.description: Tooltip of a tab group header while the group is closed; clicking shows its tabs. $1 is the group's name.

treePinned.description: Screen-reader label of the pin icon on a tab row: the tab is pinned in Chrome. One word.

treeSelectTab.description: Screen-reader label of the tick box on a tab row. $1 is the tab's title (or its address when it has none).

treeSelectTabHint.message: Seleccionar esta pestaña (Mayús + clic selecciona un intervalo)
treeSelectTabHint.description: Tooltip of the tick box on a tab row. Shift-click ticks every tab between this one and the one ticked last.

treeShowMoreTabs_one.description: Button under a very large window's tab list that shows the next tabs. $1 is the formatted count of tabs it will add. Button text, keep short.

treeShowMoreTabs_other.description: Button under a very large window's tab list that shows the next tabs. $1 is the formatted count of tabs it will add. Button text, keep short.

treeSessionMeta.description: One line of facts about a saved session or snapshot. $1 is a window count such as "3 windows", $2 a tab count such as "87 tabs", $3 its size on disk such as "2.1 KB". Keep the middle dot separators unless your language uses another.

treeSizeBytes.description: A storage size in bytes. $1 is the formatted number. Keep the unit symbol short.

treeSizeKilobytes.description: A storage size in kilobytes (1024 bytes). $1 is the formatted number with one decimal. Keep the unit symbol short.

treeSizeMegabytes.description: A storage size in megabytes (1024 x 1024 bytes). $1 is the formatted number with one decimal. Keep the unit symbol short.

searchOpenWindowsName.description: Name shown for the browser's currently open windows in search results, where a saved session's name would otherwise appear (e.g. "Open windows · Window 2"). Short.

searchGroupMatchingSessions.description: Heading of the search results group listing saved sessions whose name matches the query. Shown in small capitals; short.

searchGroupOpenTabs.description: Heading of the search results group listing matching tabs that are open in the browser now. Shown in small capitals; short.

searchGroupSavedSessions.description: Heading of the search results group listing matching tabs inside saved sessions. Shown in small capitals; short.

searchGroupHistory.description: Heading of the search results group listing matching tabs inside automatic snapshots. Shown in small capitals; short. Use the same word for snapshots as everywhere else.

searchLabel.description: Accessible name of the search box at the top of the app page. One word.

searchInputTitle.message: Buscar en las pestañas abiertas, las sesiones guardadas y sus direcciones
searchInputTitle.description: Tooltip of the search box at the top of the app page.

searchPlaceholder.description: Placeholder text inside the empty search box. The "/" is the keyboard key that focuses the box; keep it as is. Keep it short enough to fit a narrow box (about 40 characters).

searchClear.description: Tooltip and accessible name of the X button that empties the search box.

searchResultPlace.description: Where a matching tab is, shown beside it in search results. $1 is the session name (or the name for the open windows), $2 is the window's number (1, 2, ...). Short; it is cut off when too long.

searchRestoreSession.description: Button beside a session in search results that opens the whole session again. Button text, short.

searchResultCount_one.description: Number of search results, beside the results heading and read out by screen readers. $1 is the formatted count.

searchResultCount_other.description: Number of search results, beside the results heading and read out by screen readers. $1 is the formatted count.

searchStillLoading.message: Aún se están cargando las sesiones…
searchStillLoading.description: Shown beside the result count while saved sessions are still being read, so more results may appear.

searchNoMatches.description: Shown when a search finds nothing. $1 is the text the user typed.

searchShowMore.description: Button under a group of search results that shows more of them. Button text, short.

storageSessionNotFound.description: Error shown when an action targets a saved session or snapshot that no longer exists (deleted elsewhere). $1 is the session's internal id.

storageUnnamedSession.description: Fallback name for a session in the sidebar when its stored record has no name (e.g. saved by a newer version). Short, like a title.

storageUnknownError.description: Shown in error lines and toasts when a failure carries no message. Short.

errorGeneric.message: Algo salió mal. Los detalles están en la consola del navegador.
errorGeneric.description: Shown in error lines and toasts for a failure the extension cannot explain (the technical details go to the browser console).

errorSessionChanged.message: La sesión ha cambiado mientras tanto. Inténtalo de nuevo.
errorSessionChanged.description: Error when a window, tab or group that was on screen is no longer in the stored session (it was changed in another tab, or by the automatic snapshots).

errorDataUnreadable.message: No se pudieron leer los datos guardados.
errorDataUnreadable.description: Error when stored session data is damaged and cannot be read.

errorDataTooNew.message: Estos datos se guardaron con una versión más reciente de Tab Organizer. Actualiza la extensión para usarlos.
errorDataTooNew.description: Error when stored data was written by a newer version of the extension. Tab Organizer is the extension name.

errorRestoreNoWindow.message: Chrome no abrió ninguna ventana en la que restaurar.
errorRestoreNoWindow.description: Error when Chrome did not open the new window a restore asked for.

errorTabsBusy.message: Chrome está ocupado con las pestañas, quizá porque se está arrastrando una. Inténtalo de nuevo.
errorTabsBusy.description: Error when Chrome refuses to change tabs for a moment, usually because a tab is being dragged.

errorTabGone.message: Esa pestaña o ventana ya no está abierta.
errorTabGone.description: Error when the tab, window or tab group an action was meant for has been closed meanwhile.

errorWindowBounds.message: La posición guardada de la ventana no cabe en esta pantalla.
errorWindowBounds.description: Error when a restored window's saved position and size do not fit the current screen.

errorNotAllowed.message: El navegador no lo ha permitido.
errorNotAllowed.description: Error when the browser refused an action such as copying to the clipboard (for example because the page was not focused).

storageQuotaNotice.message: El almacenamiento está lleno. Elimina instantáneas o sesiones antiguas.
storageQuotaNotice.description: Red notice shown when saving or importing fails because the extension's local storage is full.

storageShowStorageUse.description: Small button on the 'storage is full' notice; scrolls to the storage meter in Settings. Button, keep short.

storageTotalLine.description: Storage meter headline in Settings. $1 is a size such as '4.6 MB'.

storageDetailLine.description: Storage meter breakdown under the headline. $1 is the size of saved sessions (e.g. '1.2 MB'), $2 the counted phrase storageSavedSessionCount (e.g. '3 saved sessions'), $3 the size of snapshots, $4 the counted phrase storageSnapshotCount (e.g. '12 snapshots'). Keep the middle dot separator.

storageSavedSessionCount_one.description: Counted noun phrase used inside storage messages (singular). $1 is the number.

storageSavedSessionCount_other.description: Counted noun phrase used inside storage messages (plural). $1 is the number.

storageSnapshotCount_one.description: Counted noun phrase for automatic snapshots used inside storage messages (singular). $1 is the number.

storageSnapshotCount_other.description: Counted noun phrase for automatic snapshots used inside storage messages (plural). $1 is the number.

storageSnapshotHint.message: Las instantáneas automáticas ocupan $1. Reduce «Conservar las últimas» o elimina las instantáneas no protegidas.
storageSnapshotHint.description: Hint under the storage meter when snapshots take most of the space. $1 is a size such as '3.4 MB'. The quoted label is the setting settingsKeepLast; quote its translated text exactly.

storageHeading.description: Heading of the storage meter section in Settings. One or two words.

storageMeasuring.description: Shown in the storage meter while the used space is being measured. Short.

storageDeleteUnprotected.description: Small button under the storage meter that deletes every automatic snapshot that is not protected. Button, keep short.

storageDeleteUnprotectedTooltip.message: Eliminar todas las instantáneas que no estén protegidas
storageDeleteUnprotectedTooltip.description: Tooltip of the 'Delete all unprotected' button.

storageDeleteAllData.message: Eliminar todos los datos de sesiones
storageDeleteAllData.description: Small destructive button under the storage meter that deletes all saved sessions and snapshots. Button, keep short.

storageDeleteAllDataTooltip.message: Eliminar todas las sesiones guardadas e instantáneas de este dispositivo
storageDeleteAllDataTooltip.description: Tooltip of the 'Delete all session data' button.

storageDeletedAllNotice.message: Se han eliminado todos los datos de sesiones. Tu configuración se ha conservado.
storageDeletedAllNotice.description: Toast shown after all session data was deleted.

storageDeletedUnprotectedNotice_one.message: Se ha eliminado $1 instantánea no protegida.
storageDeletedUnprotectedNotice_one.description: Toast after deleting unprotected snapshots (singular). $1 is the number deleted.

storageDeletedUnprotectedNotice_other.message: Se han eliminado $1 instantáneas no protegidas.
storageDeletedUnprotectedNotice_other.description: Toast after deleting unprotected snapshots (plural). $1 is the number deleted.

storageDeleteHistoryTitle.description: Title of the confirm dialog for 'Delete all unprotected'.

storageDeleteHistoryBody_one.message: Se eliminará $1 instantánea de este dispositivo. Las instantáneas protegidas y las sesiones guardadas se conservan. No se puede deshacer.
storageDeleteHistoryBody_one.description: Body of the confirm dialog for deleting unprotected snapshots (singular). $1 is the number of snapshots.

storageDeleteHistoryBody_other.message: Se eliminarán $1 instantáneas de este dispositivo. Las instantáneas protegidas y las sesiones guardadas se conservan. No se puede deshacer.
storageDeleteHistoryBody_other.description: Body of the confirm dialog for deleting unprotected snapshots (plural). $1 is the number of snapshots.

storageDeleteHistoryConfirm.description: Destructive confirm button in the 'Delete unprotected snapshots?' dialog. Button, keep short.

storageDeleteAllTitle.description: Title of step one of the two-step 'Delete all session data' confirm dialog.

storageDeleteAllBody.message: Se eliminarán de este dispositivo $1 y $2 ($3). Tu configuración de instantáneas y restauración se conserva, y las ventanas y pestañas abiertas no se tocan.
storageDeleteAllBody.description: Body of step one of the 'Delete all session data' dialog. $1 is the counted phrase storageSavedSessionCount (e.g. '3 saved sessions'), $2 the counted phrase storageSnapshotCount (e.g. '12 snapshots'), $3 the total size such as '4.6 MB'.

storageContinue.description: Button on step one of the 'Delete all session data' dialog that goes to the final confirmation. Button, keep short.

storageDeleteAllFinalTitle.description: Title of step two (final confirmation) of the 'Delete all session data' dialog.

storageDeleteAllFinalBody.message: Se eliminarán todas las sesiones guardadas y todas las instantáneas automáticas de este dispositivo. Si no exportaste antes una copia de seguridad, no se podrán recuperar.
storageDeleteAllFinalBody.description: Body of step two (final confirmation) of the 'Delete all session data' dialog.

storageBack.description: Button on step two of the 'Delete all session data' dialog that returns to step one. Button, keep short.

storageDeleteEverything.description: Final destructive button of the 'Delete all session data' dialog. Button, keep short.

restoreWindowLine.description: Small grey line in the restore progress toast saying which window is being filled. $1 is the window number (1-based), $2 the number of windows. Short.

restoreRate_one.description: Restore speed in the progress toast, approximate tabs per second. $1 is the number (may be a decimal such as 0.4). Very short.

restoreRate_other.description: Restore speed in the progress toast, approximate tabs per second. $1 is the number (may be a decimal such as 0.4). Very short.

restoreLazyHint.message: Las pestañas se abren sin cargar para ahorrar memoria; cada una se carga al hacer clic en ella.
restoreLazyHint.description: Grey hint in the restore progress toast while tabs are opened without loading them.

restoreLazyDone_one.message: $1 pestaña se ha quedado sin cargar y se cargará al hacer clic.
restoreLazyDone_one.description: Grey line under the restore result. $1 is the number of tabs opened without loading.

restoreLazyDone_other.message: $1 pestañas se han quedado sin cargar y se cargarán al hacer clic.
restoreLazyDone_other.description: Grey line under the restore result. $1 is the number of tabs opened without loading.

restoreDestinationHere.description: Sentence in the confirm dialog before opening a large session into the current window. $1 is the session name.

restoreDestinationNewWindows_one.description: Sentence in the confirm dialog before opening a large session in new windows. $1 is the number of windows, $2 the session name.

restoreDestinationNewWindows_other.description: Sentence in the confirm dialog before opening a large session in new windows. $1 is the number of windows, $2 the session name.

restoreProgress_one.description: Main line of the restore progress toast. $1 is the total number of tabs, $2 how many are open so far. (English keeps 'tabs' in both forms.)

restoreProgress_other.description: Main line of the restore progress toast. $1 is the total number of tabs, $2 how many are open so far.

restoreCancelling.description: Label of the Cancel button in the restore progress toast after it was pressed, while the restore stops. Button, keep short.

restoreSummaryRestored_one.description: First clause of the restore result in the toast; further clauses follow, separated by ' · '. $1 is the number of tabs attempted, $2 how many opened.

restoreSummaryRestored_other.description: First clause of the restore result in the toast; further clauses follow, separated by ' · '. $1 is the number of tabs attempted, $2 how many opened.

restoreSummaryCancelled_one.description: First clause of the result of a cancelled restore; further clauses may follow, separated by ' · '. $1 is the number of tabs opened before Cancel.

restoreSummaryCancelled_other.description: First clause of the result of a cancelled restore; further clauses may follow, separated by ' · '. $1 is the number of tabs opened before Cancel.

restoreSummaryDiscarded_one.message: $1 pestaña se cargará al hacer clic
restoreSummaryDiscarded_one.description: Clause of the restore result (joined with ' · '), lower-case start in English. $1 is the number of tabs opened without loading.

restoreSummaryDiscarded_other.message: $1 pestañas se cargarán al hacer clic
restoreSummaryDiscarded_other.description: Clause of the restore result (joined with ' · '), lower-case start in English. $1 is the number of tabs opened without loading.

restoreSummaryKept.message: las pestañas ya abiertas se han conservado
restoreSummaryKept.description: Clause of the result of a cancelled restore (joined with ' · '), lower-case start in English: cancelling does not close the tabs already opened.

restoreSummarySkipped_one.description: Clause of the restore result (joined with ' · '). $1 is the number of tabs not opened because their address cannot be opened by an extension.

restoreSummarySkipped_other.description: Clause of the restore result (joined with ' · '). $1 is the number of tabs not opened because their address cannot be opened by an extension.

restoreSummaryFailed_one.description: Clause of the restore result (joined with ' · '). $1 is the number of tabs Chrome failed to open.

restoreSummaryFailed_other.description: Clause of the restore result (joined with ' · '). $1 is the number of tabs Chrome failed to open.

restoreSummaryProblems_one.description: Clause of the restore result (joined with ' · '). $1 is the number of tab groups or window states that could not be recreated.

restoreSummaryProblems_other.description: Clause of the restore result (joined with ' · '). $1 is the number of tab groups or window states that could not be recreated.

restoreSkippedItem.description: List item under the restore result. $1 is the address of a tab that was not opened.

restoreFailedItem.description: List item under the restore result. $1 is the address of a tab that failed to open, $2 the reason, a complete sentence already in your language.

restoreFailedItemPlain.description: List item under the restore result when there is no reason that can be shown. $1 is the address of a tab that failed to open.

restoreProblemGroup.message: No se pudo recrear el grupo «$1» ($2)
restoreProblemGroup.description: List item under the restore result. $1 is the name of a tab group that could not be recreated, $2 the reason, a complete sentence already in your language.

restoreProblemGroupPlain.message: No se pudo recrear el grupo «$1».
restoreProblemGroupPlain.description: List item under the restore result. $1 is the name of a tab group that could not be recreated.

restoreProblemActivate.description: List item under the restore result. $1 is the address of the tab that should have been the window's active tab, $2 the reason, a complete sentence already in your language.

restoreProblemActivatePlain.description: List item under the restore result. $1 is the address of the tab that should have been the window's active tab.

restoreProblemWindowState.message: No se pudo restaurar el tamaño de la ventana ($1)
restoreProblemWindowState.description: List item under the restore result when a window could not be maximized, minimized or made full screen as saved. $1 is the reason, a complete sentence already in your language.

restoreProblemWindowStatePlain.message: No se pudo restaurar el tamaño de la ventana.
restoreProblemWindowStatePlain.description: List item under the restore result when a window could not be maximized, minimized or made full screen as saved.

restoreDismiss.description: Tooltip and screen-reader label of the x button that closes the restore result toast.

restoreSessionTooNew.message: Esta sesión se guardó con una versión más reciente de Tab Organizer y no se puede mostrar.
restoreSessionTooNew.description: Error shown in place of a session whose stored format is from a newer version of the extension. Tab Organizer is the extension name.

workerMenuSaveAll.message: Guardar todas las ventanas como sesión
workerMenuSaveAll.description: Item in the toolbar icon's right-click menu: saves every open window as one session. Menu item, keep it short (under 40 characters). The Open tabs first-run hint quotes this label too, so it must match the menu.

workerDuplicatesGroupTitle.description: Title of a Chrome tab group that holds duplicate tabs whose address has no host name. $1 is the number of tabs in the group (already formatted). Shown on the small tab group chip, keep it very short (under 20 characters).

workerDuplicatesHostGroupTitle.description: Title of a Chrome tab group that holds duplicate tabs of one address. $1 is the site's host name (such as example.com, never translated), $2 the number of tabs in the group (already formatted). Shown on the small tab group chip, keep it very short.
